svg.title: How Poppy Uses Prisma Client to Ship Confidently
svg.desc: The figure 1.5M set large on light paper, labelled as the rides taken on Poppy's fleet served by Prisma Client, with the fleet's 500 shared cars, 400 e-scooters and 200 e-steps named beneath. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand.
